title: P15.9-B5.5 R1: cost canonical field mapping, shared theme sync, credential-scoped invalidation + SSE lifecycle
description: R1 audit fixes on PR #101 (B5.5 system pages). F1 — SystemCost maps canonical P13 fields exactly: policy limit reads max_microusd (never limit_microusd); scope shows business_id + scope_type + scope_id as distinct cells; profile shows fixed_microusd, input/output_microusd_per_mtok, reserve_microusd plus billing_mode, ref_type:ref_id, currency, status, version. usd() accepts only verified integer micro-USD within safe bounds — null/missing/floats/strings render "unknown", never $0; real zeros stay $0. Read-only. F2 — useTheme toggle computes next from localStorage then dispatches pair.theme-changed so all same-tab consumers converge; stale state never overwrites a newer selection; one toggle = one transition; cross-tab sync preserved. F3 — credential-scoped invalidation + SSE lifecycle: pair.operator-changed and new pair.credentials-changed bump the InboxCountsProvider epoch — old-credential resolutions never repaint (stale forEpoch suppressed at render boundary) and counts refetch under the new header; reconnectStream clears the previously-authenticated event buffer, notifies buffer subscribers + resync listeners (live projections refetch under new creds), recreates the single EventSource; stream status is a lifecycle-safe subscription set (all mounted consumers consistent, unmounted stop). No new auth backend, no credential values in UI/logs. E2E: +6 adversarial tests covering canonical P13 fixtures, null/noncanonical-not-$0, theme alternation + reload, operator-A badge never under B, delayed old-operator read, SSE buffer clear + fails-closed reconnect, shared status convergence. UI-only; zero backend/schema/dependency changes.
